result.title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
result.summary: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. On a training pool with graded answers, we analyse the executor's failures, run it under several strategies to see which one worked on each input, and let a teacher that sees the grades and the traces write the advice that would have helped. The advisor then learns, by supervised fine-tuning, to write that advice from the input alone. Because the student is a separate small model rather than the executor, it is cheap to train and adds little latency. We call this approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD). On FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of expert-written financial research queries, an 8B advisor raises the qualification rate of Samaya's proprietary research agent, which already leads the benchmark's leaderboard, from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the agent's own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query. We study the generalization of the proposed approach, and in particular show that HSAD also improves results on WebShop, BIRD text-to-SQL and ExpertLongBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HSAD：让能看到评分与执行轨迹的教师，针对训练池中每个输入回溯分析 executor 的失败、比较不同策略的效果并写出「本应有帮助」的结构化建议，再用监督微调训练一个 8B 小 advisor，使其仅凭输入即可生成建议，拼接到冻结 executor 的提示中。在 FrontierFinance 上把某商用研究 agent 的合格率从 52.9% 提到 56.6%，单次查询成本降低约 37%，并在 WebShop、BIRD、ExpertLongBench 上观察泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但「借助 privileged 信息与轨迹回溯构造监督、训练独立小模型生成输入条件化的引导、并核查该引导是否被使用」这一训练监督与贡献分配思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 工作区的监督来源与额外计算成本设计。
